say:1:1741124001:1.text: The Twilight Pavilion is a fascinating place, don't you think?
say:1:1741124001:1.source_cn: 霁月会馆里的景象，很有趣吧。梅林阁下，您不觉得吗？
say:1:1741124001:1.male: The Twilight Pavilion is a fascinating place, don't you think?
say:1:1741124001:1.female: The Twilight Pavilion is a fascinating place, don't you think?

say:2:1741124002:1.text: Outside these walls, everyone is busy playing a part. Noble, scholar, merchant, model citizen... always acting the way people expect them to.
say:2:1741124002:1.source_cn: 人们总是习惯戴上名为“身份”“地位”“道德”的无形面具...
say:2:1741124002:1.male: Outside these walls, everyone is busy playing a part. Noble, scholar, merchant, model citizen... always acting the way people expect them to.
say:2:1741124002:1.female: Outside these walls, everyone is busy playing a part. Noble, scholar, merchant, model citizen... always acting the way people expect them to.

say:3:1741124003:1.text: But here, hidden behind magic masks, they finally stop worrying about who they're supposed to be and start showing what they really want.
say:3:1741124003:1.source_cn: 只有在霁月会馆里，在魔法的伪装下，他们才敢通过一张张有...

say:5:1741124004:1.text: The man shouting at the card table could be a respected scholar once he walks out that door.
say:5:1741124004:1.source_cn: 牌桌上举止粗鲁、大声叫骂的赌徒，走出霁月会馆外可能摇身...
say:5:1741124004:1.male: The man shouting at the card table could be a respected scholar once he walks out that door.
say:5:1741124004:1.female: The man shouting at the card table could be a respected scholar once he walks out that door.

say:6:1741124005:1.text: The high roller throwing gold around might be a tailor who counts every coin before buying bread.
say:6:1741124005:1.source_cn: 一掷千金、视金如土的豪客，实际上可能只是个平日里连一块...
say:6:1741124005:1.male: The high roller throwing gold around might be a tailor who counts every coin before buying bread.
say:6:1741124005:1.female: The high roller throwing gold around might be a tailor who counts every coin before buying bread.

say:7:1741124006:1.text: In here, none of that matters. Your title doesn't help you. Your reputation doesn't protect you. You either win, or you lose.
say:7:1741124006:1.source_cn: 在霁月会馆里，没有尊贵与卑贱、强大与弱小之分，只有赢家...
say:7:1741124006:1.male: In here, none of that matters. Your title doesn't help you. Your reputation doesn't protect you. You either win, or you lose.
say:7:1741124006:1.female: In here, none of that matters. Your title doesn't help you. Your reputation doesn't protect you. You either win, or you lose.

say:8:1741124007:1.text: The masks strip people down to who they really are: greedy, terrified, ecstatic, desperate...
say:8:1741124007:1.source_cn: 面具还原了他们作为人的本性，贪婪、恐惧、狂喜、绝望……
say:8:1741124007:1.male: The masks strip people down to who they really are: greedy, terrified, ecstatic, desperate...
say:8:1741124007:1.female: The masks strip people down to who they really are: greedy, terrified, ecstatic, desperate...

say:9:1741124008:1.text: I like watching what happens when they stop pretending. It's more fascinating than any play, because none of it is acting.
say:9:1741124008:1.source_cn: 我喜欢观察他们摘下伪装后暴露无遗的样子。那比任何戏剧都...
say:9:1741124008:1.male: I like watching what happens when they stop pretending. It's more fascinating than any play, because none of it is acting.
say:9:1741124008:1.female: I like watching what happens when they stop pretending. It's more fascinating than any play, because none of it is acting.

say:12:1741124010:1.text: Then come by more often when you have time.
say:12:1741124010:1.source_cn: 闲暇时，请多来霁月会馆转转吧。
say:12:1741124010:1.male: Then come by more often when you have time.
say:12:1741124010:1.female: Then come by more often when you have time.

say:13:1741124011:1.text: I'd like to see if you can stay that calm when you're in a game you can't control.
say:13:1741124011:1.source_cn: 我很好奇……当您面对一场无法掌控的赌局时，是否还能保持...
